releaseNotes.zh-CN:
ADC 0.2.7（测试渠道）

复用 HTTP 连接，并为 DNS、请求和屏幕操作设置明确的时间预算，降低非模型调用开销。
当前工具支持时，可随屏幕动作返回操作后的界面；使用新的快照引用进行后续操作。
补充可点击父节点与同一行上下文，改善重复标签、搜索结果和输入框的定位。
过期快照、未找到目标和结果未知会被明确区分，避免盲目重放操作。
应用覆盖升级后恢复 Node 与无障碍绑定，保留用户接管和控制会话到期行为。
更新屏幕控制提示、通知与可拖动边缘提示。

沿用现有测试版签名，支持覆盖升级并保留配对信息与本地权限。
安装仍需设备所有者确认。更新后刷新 MCP 工具目录。
releaseNotes.en:
ADC 0.2.7 (testing channel)

Reuses HTTP connections and bounds DNS, request and screen-operation time to reduce engineering overhead.
When supported by the current catalog, screen actions return the resulting interface; use the fresh snapshot for the next action.
Clickable ancestry and same-row context improve duplicate-label, search-result and editable-field targeting.
Stale snapshots, missing targets and unknown outcomes remain distinct so uncertain actions are not blindly replayed.
In-place updates restore the Node and Accessibility binding while preserving user takeover and screen-control expiry.
Updates screen-control notifications and the draggable edge indicator.

Retains the existing testing certificate for in-place upgrades with pairing and local permissions preserved.
Installation remains under the device owner's control. Refresh the MCP catalog after updating.
